recommendedTextbook.title: New General Mathematics for Junior Secondary Schools 1 (UBE Edition)
recommendedTextbook.author: M.F. Macrae, A.O. Kalejaiye, Z.I. Chima
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education & NERDC

topics.topic: Whole Numbers: Place Value and Large Numbers in Base 10
subtopics: Counting and writing numbers up to billions
Place value of digits in whole numbers
Writing figures in words and words in figures (Nigerian budget figures)
objectives: State place value and face value of digits in numbers up to 1,000,000,000
Express large numbers in words and figures accurately
Read economic budget statistics from Nigerian newspapers

topics.topic: Factors, Multiples, Prime Numbers, LCM and HCF
subtopics: Prime numbers between 1 and 100
Prime factorization (factor trees and index form)
Finding Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) and Highest Common Factor (HCF)
objectives: Express positive integers as products of their prime factors in index notation
Calculate HCF and LCM of 2 and 3 numbers using prime factor method
Apply LCM and HCF to solve practical market distribution problems

topics.topic: Fractions: Proper, Improper, Mixed and Equivalent Fractions
subtopics: Types of fractions and representations on number lines
Rules for generating equivalent fractions
Conversion between mixed numbers and improper fractions
objectives: Classify fractions into proper, improper, and mixed forms
Simplify fractions to their lowest irreducible terms
Compare fractional portions of agricultural harvests

topics.topic: Arithmetic Operations on Fractions: Addition and Subtraction
subtopics: Addition and subtraction of fractions with like and unlike denominators
Operations on mixed numbers with borrowing and regrouping
Real-life fractional budgeting word problems in Naira
objectives: Evaluate addition and subtraction of fractions using LCM of denominators
Solve two-step word problems involving fractional expenditures

topics.topic: Decimals, Percentages & Everyday Market Arithmetic (Financial Literacy Integration)
subtopics: Conversion between fractions, decimals and percentages
Calculating discounts, profits and sales margins in Nigerian local markets (Balogun, Kurmi, Onitsha)
E-Naira and modern electronic payment calculations
objectives: Convert decimals to percentages with 90% accuracy.
Calculate percentage profit on transactions in Naira and Kobo.
Apply financial literacy rules to personal budget planning.

topics.topic: Decimals and Percentages: Conversions and Everyday Arithmetic
subtopics: Converting fractions to decimals and decimals to fractions
Percentage conversions (out of 100)
Calculating percentage increase and decrease in commodity prices
objectives: Convert recurring and terminating fractions to decimal form
Calculate percentage discounts on school uniform purchases
Solve practical trading profit drills in Nigerian currency

subtopics: Diagnostic evaluation on numbers, fractions, decimals, and BODMAS
Tiered remediation for struggling learners
objectives: Verify student mastery of foundational junior mathematics

topics.topic: Approximation and Estimation: Significant Figures and Decimal Places
subtopics: Rounding off whole numbers to nearest ten, hundred, thousand
Rounding decimals to given number of decimal places
Approximating numbers to 1, 2, and 3 significant figures
objectives: Round off numbers correctly applying the 5-up/4-down rule
Distinguish between decimal places and significant figures
Estimate market shopping cart totals quickly without calculators

topics.topic: Introduction to Algebra: Symbols, Variables and Open Sentences
subtopics: Use of letters/symbols to represent unknown numbers
Translating English statements into algebraic expressions
Evaluating expressions by numerical substitution
objectives: Translate verbal phrases (e.g., 'twice a number plus 5') into algebraic terms
Substitute positive integers into algebraic expressions to find numerical values

topics.topic: Simplification of Algebraic Expressions and Collecting Like Terms
subtopics: Identification of like and unlike algebraic terms
Addition and subtraction of algebraic terms
Removing single brackets with positive and negative multipliers
objectives: Group and simplify like terms with correct signs
Expand brackets applying the distributive law correctly

topics.topic: Simple Linear Equations in One Unknown Variable
subtopics: Meaning of an equation and balance scale analogy
Solving linear equations using inverse operations (additive and multiplicative inverses)
Checking solutions by back-substitution
objectives: Solve one-step and two-step linear equations (e.g., 3x + 7 = 22)
Verify correctness of solutions through back-substitution

topics.topic: Word Problems Leading to Simple Linear Equations
subtopics: Setting up equations from everyday Nigerian commercial situations
Solving age, money, and measurement word problems
Interpreting solutions in practical context
objectives: Formulate linear equations representing real-world situations
Solve word problems and state answers with appropriate units

subtopics: Review of whole numbers, fractions, decimals, and basic algebra
Terminal examination and record of marks
objectives: Complete JSS 1 Mathematics Term 1 evaluation
